title: Floors and Ceilings
briefing: Orchard Foods is bouncing between a floor near $48.50 and a ceiling near $51.50. Buy near the floor, protect it, and aim for the ceiling.
objective: Support is a floor, resistance a ceiling. Enter near support with a stop just below it, and target resistance.
debrief: Orchard Foods spent the whole match in a range, turning up near $48.50 and down near $51.50 roughly every five days. A buy limit near the floor filled at a good price, a stop just below the zone protected part of the position, and a sell limit near the ceiling took profit on the rest. Buying in the middle of the range, or chasing near the ceiling, left little room to gain.

assets.name: Orchard Foods
assets.blurb: Runs a chain of neighborhood grocery stores.
